title: Attainment of interior Gaussian probabilities
statement: For every real number $\alpha$ with $0<\alpha<1$, there exists $t\in\mathbb R$ such that the standard Gaussian cumulative distribution function satisfies $\Phi(t)=\alpha$.
replaced: Let $\Phi(t)=\int_{-\infty}^{t}e^{-x^2/2}/\sqrt{2\pi}\,dx$ be the standard Gaussian cumulative distribution function. For every real $\alpha$ satisfying $0<\alpha<1$, there exists a real $t$ with $\Phi(t)=\alpha$.
